title: DeepResearchSources
description: Bibliography sidecar emitted by the deep-research bibliography agent at the end of Phase 2. Ground-truth artifact for downstream synthesis, compiler, and research-accuracy-verifier consumption. Field names mirror skills/research-accuracy-verifier/schemas/intake.json §CitedPaper for cross-skill compatibility. Validated by skills/deep-research/scripts/validate_sidecar.py + predicates S1-S4.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when bibliography phase completed.

mode.description: Active deep-research mode. Drives downstream sidecar gating per SIDECAR_SPECS.

topic_slug.description: Topic slug used in the report filename (e.g. 'kras-inhibitors').

search_contract_version.description: Version of the search contract from Phase 1, if available.

rq.description: Research question text from Phase 1 contract.

sub_question_id.description: For a PARTIAL sources sidecar from Phase-3 fan-out, the decomposition sub-question id (e.g. 'SQ2') that produced it. Null/absent for a full or merged sidecar.

merged_from.description: For a MERGED sources sidecar, the list of sub-question ids whose partial sidecars were combined by merge_sources.py. Null/absent for a non-merged sidecar.

search_log.description: Per-database search audit (from bibliography agent §Search Documentation).

Source.description: One bibliographic entry. paper_id is the join key for downstream sidecars (grading, synthesis, advocate).

paper_id.description: Stable identifier. Prefer DOI; fallback PMID; fallback slug. Used as join key across all sidecars.

year.description: Publication year. Null for in-press / undated grey lit (use grey_lit_note then).

venue.description: Journal, conference, preprint server, or grey-lit publisher.

source.description: Database that surfaced the source. Used for provenance tracking in the Search Log.

study_design.description: Free-text study design (e.g. 'RCT', 'cohort', 'in vitro', 'systematic review'). Drives evidence_level grading.

key_findings.description: 2-3 sentence summary of the source's contribution to the RQ.

relevance.description: Bibliography-agent assessment of relevance to the RQ.

reception.description: Scite reception data when available. Null when not assessed.

grey_lit_note.description: Required when source == 'GreyLit'. Documents publisher / agency / fetch date per citable_web_domains.md.

query.description: Verbatim query string as submitted. Reproducibility-critical — do NOT paraphrase.
